description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ReportData' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report'. The interface declares methods for normalizing report data into an array and retrieving metadata as a 'ParameterBag'. It also includes licensing and project information in comments.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns the report data normalized as an associative array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the report data as a ParameterBag, or null if not available.
